audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side both read Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank — the inverse of what every why[] and spike on the page says, and the inverse of the mirror.
audit.why: Win rate is 50.48% over 830 games (EVEN), and the packet chart plus the mirror audit (gangplank__warwick, 'both layers set to the packet chart') give Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Gangplank, Gangplank. The whys[] on this page already tell that story; only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Gangplank, Gangplank on both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled to match. diff EVEN kept; diffRating dropped from 8.5/10 to 5.5/10 and tone moved off the HARD red, since 8.5/10 contradicted both EVEN and a 50.48% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] and phases[6] were generic Warwick-spike boilerplate on stages Gangplank owns.
audit.why: Gangplank's flip is his Sheen breakpoint on Parrrley (625 range, flat 4.5s at every rank) against your 365-range Q, and Cannon Barrage is global on 160/140/120s.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and phases[6].why now state the Sheen/Parrrley range gap and the global R timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text told you to 'hold Q to follow his dash'. Gangplank has no dash. breakdown.cooldowns treated Powder Keg as a tracked cooldown.
audit.why: Powder Keg's cooldown reads 0 in the kit because it is charge-based — it is never 'down', so advice keyed to its cooldown is unactionable. The real trackable timer is Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14s, his only heal and cleanse. Primal Howl (15s at rank 1) is 2.5s of damage reduction ending in a 1s flee, which is the actual answer to a barrel detonation.
audit.corrected: Dash reference removed, Remove Scurvy's 22s named as the cooldown to bait, Powder Keg reframed as charges to be killed rather than waited out, Primal Howl's timer added to the bad-trade rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places (spikes[0], spikes[1], whys[3]-adjacent mid text, wants.you[0]) rest on Remove Scurvy either cleansing or failing to cleanse Infinite Duress's suppression.
audit.why: Riot's text for Remove Scurvy says only 'cure crowd control effects' and says nothing about suppression eligibility; the kit file's needsResearch is empty by design, so this is UNKNOWN, not 'no'. The mirror agent hit the same wall and left the sentences intact.
audit.corrected: Left every one of those sentences untouched. Recorded in unverified and raised as a question.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Your Infinite Duress' and 'Powder Kegs' — both are the correct names (a possessive pronoun and a plural). False positives.

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger heals you on every auto once you are under half health, and Parrrley chip cannot out-pace it at level 1 — walk him down.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s and it is a channel, so leap on top of a placed barrel before he detonates it — 110s at rank 1 means one wasted ult is a lost lane.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen breakpoints flip this stage: his empowered Parrrley hits from 625 range while your Q reaches 365.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he kites you out, and Cannon Barrage is global on 120s at rank 3 — close the game before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy: 22s at rank 1 and his only heal — force it out, then commit. - Powder Keg banks charges, so it is never truly down: kill the barrel instead of waiting. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Pop barrels to deny poke and gold — Kegs bank charges, so kill them on sight.
